description: Free oscillation of the first sloshing mode in a closed rectangular tank (L = 1 m, h = 0.5 m, kh = pi/2), CFD: initial surface tilted plane with 5 mm at the walls (F 60 / F 62 / F 63), gauge at x = L/6 where the third mode has a node; period at a gauge against linear theory (T = 1.1816 s).

reference.citation: Free oscillation of the first sloshing mode, linear potential theory T = 2 pi / sqrt(g k tanh kh), k = pi/L (e.g. Faltinsen & Timokha 2009, Sloshing, Ch. 4)
